text:
Maya: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to Jules and Ravi for rescuing the office fiddle after the lunch spill 😅
Jules: haha glad it lived! rescued it with duct tape and prayer :joy:
Ravi: brought a spare pot and some soil, also learned fiddle plants hate hot soup 🤦‍♂️
Ava: legendary plant recovery team! :seedling: :tada:
Priya: Facilities deserves props too for the quick cleanup — you made the spill disappear 🙌
Facilities: Happy to help! We keep a stash of spare pots and gloves in Closet B if anyone needs them.
Maya: also, bonus points to Jules for the tiny plant sign "Do Not Feed" 😂
Jules: putting it by the window now. houseplant cam tomorrow? :camera:
Ravi: I'll water it on Friday. adding to my calendar reminder (so it's official)
Ava: adding a kudos — thanks y'all. small wins = big mood :sparkles:
Maya: filing a picnic-era incident in case anyone wants to meme it later :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Priya: omg yes, meme away. might make a sticker
Maya: @Facilities where's Closet B exactly? I keep getting lost.
Facilities: it's by the supply cabinets next to the coffee maker, key code 4-2-7 on the keypad (kidding about the code) :smile:
reminder-bot: Don't forget to water the plants! Next reminder scheduled Fri 09:00am
Ava: :heart:
